body:
## Ask, Match, and Gather

A word needs one representation to ask what it needs, another to advertise what it contains, and another to supply information.

These roles are called query, key, and value. Query-key matches become scores; softmax turns them into weights; the weighted values are added.

Scaling the scores keeps softmax from becoming too extreme when vectors are wide. Masks block positions that must not be consulted.
common_mistakes: Attention always selects exactly one word.
Queries, keys, and values are raw English questions and answers.
A causal mask reveals future tokens during generation.
mini_exercise: Draw “Ask, Match, and Gather” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Attention is the core routing idea that lets transformers connect distant information.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Ask, Match, and Gather,” explain Attention Mechanism without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
